info.name: Magis Space API
info.description: REST API for finding vacant study rooms. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman) against a fresh database with the mock SMS server running. Folders: Setup, then one folder per controller, then Cleanup. Change baseUrl if the app runs on another port.

item.name: Setup
item.description: Looks up seeded ids and sets per-run values. Run these first. They change no data.

item.name: Setup - run id, today and tomorrow

request.description:
Sets the collection variables run (unique suffix for this run), today and tomorrow (day names in the machine time zone). Also reads the amenity list and stores the id of the seeded "Outlets" amenity as outletsId.
Input: none. Output: array of amenities. Errors: none.

exec: pm.test("Seeded Outlets amenity exists", function () { pm.expect(outlets).to.exist; });

request.description:
Lists all rooms with live status.
Input: optional query building, minCapacity (positive integer), amenity (name).
Output: array of Room objects (status, predictedVacant, lastReportedAt, minutesAgo).
Errors: 400 if minCapacity is not a positive number.

exec: pm.test("Returns an array with the seeded rooms", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(7); pm.expect(j[0]).to.have.all.keys("id","name","building","floor","capacity","mapX","mapY","latitude","longitude","amenities","status","predictedVacant","lastReportedAt","minutesAgo"); });

request.description:
Filters by building, minimum capacity and amenity name. All filters are optional and combine with AND.
Input: query building, minCapacity, amenity.
Output: array of Room objects.

item.name: Availability
item.description: ReportController: /availability, plus the per-room report and history endpoints

request.description:
Reports a room as occupied (occupied=true) or vacant (false). reportedAt and verified are set by the server.
Input: roomId, studentId, occupied.
Output: Report object.
Errors: 422 missing fields, 404 unknown student or room, 409 the same student reported the same room less than 10 minutes ago.
Uses the seeded student on the room created in this run, so the 10-minute rule does not interfere. Saves reportId.

The room now shows the latest report.
Output: Room object with status OCCUPIED, minutesAgo and lastReportedAt set.

exec: pm.test("OCCUPIED, predictedVacant false", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("OCCUPIED"); pm.expect(j.predictedVacant).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.minutesAgo).to.be.within(0, 1); pm.expect(j.lastReportedAt).to.be.a("string"); });
